description: Read how this organization's MergeSafe is set up: for each setting its effective value, where the value comes from (repo_override, org, mixed with field_sources, mergesafe_default, or unchecked when it could not be read) and the values it may take, plus the settings version. Give the org (its GitHub login); add repo for that repository's effective settings. Read-only. A Member sees no billing fields.
name: get_settings
title: Read settings
